description.narrative: Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta, S.A.B. de C.V. (Vesta) is a leading Mexican real estate company specializing in high-quality industrial properties (IPs) and providing common infrastructure and services (energy, water, wastewater, and waste management) to tenants. Vesta negotiated a new senior unsecured credit facility of US$ 545 million, comprising of: (i) a US$345 million in term loans and a (ii) US$200 million revolving loan. IFC contributed with US$100 million to the facility. IFC co-structured and co-led the facility together with certain commercial banks. The financing is structured as a Sustainability-Linked Loan (SSL) with a spread reduction incentive tied to achieving specific certification objectives. The proceeds will partially fund Vestas 2025-2026 investment program (the Project").

The most significant expected Project-level outcomes are (i) stakeholder effects on customers through increased access to high-quality industrial assets, and (ii) environmental effects through improved resource efficiency of green buildings. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will promote greater sustainability in Mexicos property sector. As one of the largest industrial asset developers, the potential portfolio-wide greening of Vesta will provide a highly visible demonstration case and spur further competition among other institutional real estate players, which could have a catalytic impact on the industrial real estate market in the country.
